Important Information:

Apply early (Before Oct 20th 2026) for an absentee ballot.
Ballots need at least 7 days to travel to voters and at least another 7 to return to the Clerk's office.
Same Day Registration (SDR) is available at every polling location.
Read more about SDR here.

General Election - Nov 3, 2026

This is a General Election, meaning anyone who is registered to vote is eligible to participate.
